prompt:
Next month you are having repair work done on the roof of your home. The work will be noisy and the workers will need to reach the roof from the side of the building.

Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter:

- explain what work is being done and how long it will take
- describe how the work may affect your neighbour
- ask your neighbour to let the workers use the path beside their house
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.
key_points: The work must be described: what will be done, the start and end dates, and what time of day
The effect on the neighbour must be described honestly (noise, dust, the path being temporarily closed)
The scope of the request must be clear: which path, how many days, how many people, cleaning up afterwards
Apologising for the inconvenience up front and thanking the neighbour makes the request acceptable
A way of getting in touch should be left in case a problem arises
common_mistakes: Making the request bluntly without softening it ('Your path will be used by my workers')
Not giving the duration or dates at all
Using a tone that is either too formal or too casual in a semi-formal letter to a neighbour
Forgetting to cover the third bullet point and turning the letter into pure information
topic: home repairs and a request to a neighbour
